messages.content: User task: Look up research on homomorphic encryption schemes

raw_response:
Recent research on homomorphic encryption (HE) focuses on improving efficiency, security, and applicability. The CKKS scheme has seen optimizations for approximate arithmetic with reduced modulus switching and better precision management (e.g., ASIACRYPT 2023). TFHE/FHEW variants now feature faster bootstrapping and gate‑level parallelism, enabling practical programmable bootstrapping (Eurocrypt 2024). BGV‑based HE continues to be refined for integer workloads, with newer ciphertext compression techniques reducing bandwidth (Crypto 2023). Hybrid approaches combine HE with secure multiparty computation or trusted execution environments to mitigate overhead. Surveys such as “A Survey of Fully Homomorphic Encryption: Theory and Practice” (J. Cryptology 2023) provide comprehensive bibliographies.
